decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the feed for diverse backpack options including daily use, hydration, and serious hiking packs. I narrowed my consideration set to the ZOMAKE packable daypack (popular/affordable), the GZ XINXING tactical sling (high value/rugged), the High Sierra 70L (high capacity/internal frame), the N NEVO RHINO (hydration specific), and the MOSISO sling (very popular crossbody). I decided to purchase the ZOMAKE Ultra Lightweight Hiking Backpack because of its exceptional review count (nearly 15,000), high rating (4.6), and extreme portability as a packable daypack at a very low price point ($13.99), making it a low-risk, high-utility choice.
